manual_method: Corridor/running/intrusion: high-recall YOLO assist (imgsz=960, conf=0.08) followed by person-like geometric filtering, NMS IoU=0.55, strong-conf recovery, and visual verification of candidate overlays. MOT20 crowded frames: official MOTChallenge pedestrian GT (not re-invented). Intrusion shop-window mannequin/reflection band filtered after visual review.
limitation: Manual GT for corridor/running/intrusion is assist-aided and visually verified, not exhaustively pixel-perfect for every occlusion. MOT20 GT is authoritative for crowded scenes. MOT17-02 frames added as official outdoor occlusion GT.
